relevance.rationale: FILE ABSENT: the ledger row points at this path but the file does not exist anywhere in the working tree (verified by find over the whole repo; uploads/ holds 294 files and this is not one of them). The prior 2026-05-19 verification row therefore cannot be re-checked, and I could not confirm the seeded join against the document's own front matter. The verdict is undetermined on that ground alone. The corpus-side citation audit below did not need the document and is reported in full. CITATION AUDIT: the most heavily cited key among this slice's absent files - ten Lean -- Ref: sites in QOU/QGeometricLanglands.lean (lines 35, 75, 107, 167, 241, 285, 383, 443, 457, 474) plus five .ts cites[] entries across the q-geometric-langlands chapter (q-gl-conjecture, q-gl-fiber-functor, q-gl-classical-limit, q-oper, q-oper-hecke). Every site is a bare title-plus-identifier form with NO section or theorem locator, so there is nothing specific to check even had the document been present: the reference functions as chapter-level background for the classical setting the q-deformed conjectures are modelled on, not as a source for any particular statement. Defensible for a lecture-notes reference, but it means those ten Lean sites carry no verifiable attribution.

proposedActions.rationale: Ten Lean sites cite this lecture-notes volume with no section locator. Adding locators at the two or three sites where a specific classical statement is being mirrored (the oper/Hecke-eigensheaf dictionary) would turn chapter-level background into checkable attribution; the rest can stay as a single module-header reference.
